findings.summary: Deferred to integration: the diary half of AC-ra-32 (deleting the company also deletes its diary) is not verified. The diary table belongs to Phase 4 and does not exist yet. The unit's company-delete test (line 606) proves only the action_progress cascade and that the other company's rows are kept.

Deferred to integration: the PDF half of AC-ra-29 (the PDF of a previous diagnosis stays the same after tracking changes) is not verified. It needs the 'Andamento das ações' page and report documents from the phase-3-backend-action-reports unit. The API half is verified by the 'stored result never changes' suite (line 533).

Not run by this review: the Playwright specs tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts, tests/e2e/result.spec.ts and tests/e2e/history.spec.ts. They are outside this unit's Done-when and need a browser run of the app against the real backend. Owned by integration.
Not run by this review: pnpm build and node scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs. They are outside this unit's Done-when. The integration owner should run them once every wave-5 unit has landed.
Not run: the walkthrough of the actions flow in the AIOSON Play dev-link (webview renders, badge green). It needs the Play runtime, which this environment cannot start.

messages.text: IF-005 carries two error codes that the plan did not list: 409 diagnosis_not_completed (GET and PATCH on a draft; a draft has no actions) and 404 action_not_found (actionKey not in the diagnosis plan). PATCH also answers 400 validation_failed with fields._root for unknown keys (ownerName, result, diagnosisId). Record these in the IF-005 contract so the frontend and the walkthrough match.

Deferred checks for the capability-wide pass: (1) AC-ra-32 diary cascade once the Phase 4 diary table exists; (2) AC-ra-29 PDF comparison of a previous diagnosis once the reports unit's 'Andamento das ações' page exists; (3) run pnpm build, node scripts/smoke-migrate.mjs and the Playwright specs tests/e2e/actions.spec.ts, result.spec.ts and history.spec.ts against the app; (4) walk the actions flow in the Play dev-link.

Design decision accepted by this review: an archived diagnosis is left out of the company's closed list, and its plan answers isCurrent=false (PATCH 409 plan_closed). Overdue is true only for the current plan (RULE-ra-06). Ordering of 'newest' is completedAt desc then id asc in both listCompleted and listCompletedRecords, so the timeline and the action plan agree.
